term.def: An AI security audit is a formal check of how an AI system handles data, access and risk, often required by regulators before wider use.

prompt.prompt: List every AI tool our team uses today, then flag any that have not had a security or privacy review in the last [number] months.

quiz.q: Once an AI system is deployed, it can never be hacked or misused again.
quiz.why: No system is immune forever. Ongoing monitoring and audits are needed to catch new risks.

quiz.q: Regular security reviews can help catch weaknesses in AI tools before someone exploits them.
quiz.why: Audits and reviews are a standard way to find gaps before they cause real harm.

quiz.q: Only large global tech companies need to worry about AI security risks.
quiz.why: Any business using AI tools, including small firms, can be targeted or exposed to risk.
